GTA 6 Online Multiplayer Reportedly Slated for 2027 Release

Grand Theft Auto VI's online multiplayer component is reportedly planned for a 2027 release. This information emerged from a statement by Twitch's CEO, who indicated Rockstar Games' intention for the multiplayer version. Take-Two Interactive has also stated its commitment to continued support for the existing GTA Online. The game's official album was also revealed.
